source: TSY: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, re-fetched direct by THIS event's own research session 2026-09-08 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,180 bytes). notes: Canonical file written by this id's own initial research (2026-09-08) after reading the one proposal that created it, `from-tic-monthly-2026-10-16`, now shadowed. WHAT THIS EDITION IS FOR: it is the only TIC release on this calendar whose EXISTENCE is in question, and that question is now measured rather than feared. Treasury's own press-release archive was read back to 2010 and gives three appropriations lapses that covered a TIC release date; all three moved it, none published on schedule. 2013 (16-day lapse, reopened 10-17): the mid-October slot that hit 10/16-10/18 in every adjacent year landed on 10/22/2013, three business days after reopening. 2018-19 (35-day lapse, reopened 01-25): the mid-January slot that hit 01/16-01/19 in every adjacent year landed on 01/31/2019, four business days after reopening. 2025 (43-day lapse, reopened 11-12): the 10/16/2025 slot was CANCELLED outright and its data folded into 11/18/2025 alongside September's, in Treasury's own words (press release sb0317). The mechanism that separates delay from cancellation is RUNWAY, not lapse length or position: 2013 and 2019 reopened with 22 and 15 business days left before the next scheduled slot and published late; 2025 reopened with 4 and got absorbed. A missed 2026-12-15 leaves 22 business days before 2027-01-19 -- identical to 2013's, and an ordinary gap (9th longest of 23 on the published 2026-27 schedule, median 21), so the base case if a lapse happens is a DELAYED December release, not a cancelled one. A lapse would have to run past roughly 2027-01-13 (33+ days) to reach the merge zone. This CORRECTS the premise the proposal filed under, which read 12-15 as holding 'the same relative position 2025-10-16 held when it was cancelled'. Impact LOW and symbols empty for the standing reasons (16:00 ET is after the equity cash close, the data is six weeks stale, no house playbook is macro-keyed); the existence risk is a scheduling fact, not a trading edge. Nothing here licenses an entry.
